about: Acceptance extra (review F2, rounds 1 and 2): a placeholder after a combined code flag (sh -lc, bash -ec), an abbreviated one (pwsh -com), a launcher (env, ssh), a code subcommand (deno eval), or after sed, awk or Windows PowerShell even when a file comes first (GNU sed takes "-ee touch /tmp/triage-probe" from any position as an option and runs it) refuses the adapter, so a value made only of permitted characters never becomes shell code or an option.

refusedIncludes: operation sh-lc: {id} reaches the interpreter sh without a script file
operation bash-ec: {id} reaches the interpreter bash without a script file
operation pwsh-com: {id} reaches the interpreter pwsh without a script file
operation env-sh: {id} reaches env, which passes its arguments on
operation env-sh: argv holds env, a remote or container launcher
operation deno-eval: {id} reaches the interpreter deno without a script file
operation ssh-remote: {id} reaches ssh, which passes its arguments on
operation sed-file: {id} reaches sed, which takes its program or options from any of its arguments
operation awk-file: {id} reaches awk, which takes its program or options
operation powershell-file: {id} reaches powershell, which takes its program or options
